principles.applicability: Broad planar panel movement when the selected contact surface and desired motion align.
failure_signals: RGB-D feedback reports too few or inconsistent matches
the selected patch normal is poorly aligned with the requested force
conditional_actions: Inspect the current panel in another camera and reselect an opaque patch on the same moving part
use measured motion or a current joint model if a normal push does not give interpretable feedback
continue only with a fresh plan and judge progress from observed geometry and native task outcome
supporting_attempts: attempt 1: broad pushes gave unresolved tracking before a final frame-edge push returned native success
attempt 2: several broad pushes remained unresolved
attempt 4: after broad pushes and a fresh view, a frame-edge push toward the cabinet returned native success
attempt 5: broad push followed by a fresh-view palm push returned native success
principles.limits: Success followed staged pushes; the broad push alone was not sufficient evidence. Contact-stage RGB-D feedback often remained unresolved, and attempt 5 did not isolate which interval caused completion. Camera view and panel orientation changed the measured normal. This is tested on one microwave setup.

principles.applicability: Hook-pull on a door edge that appears to offer a retaining lip.
failure_signals: preview reports no hookable feature or an unobserved rear contact surface
conditional_actions: Do not execute a hook without an observed retaining surface; inspect a different visible edge or use a supported pinch/push method
supporting_attempts: attempt 2: previews on two edges returned no supported hook
principles.limits: This only describes the tested views and patches in this microwave scene; it does not show that the door has no graspable handle.

principles.applicability: Robot motion near a joint limit during contact planning.
failure_signals: preview reports start_configuration_blocked with a small joint bound violation
conditional_actions: Use the documented bounded gripper correction, inspect measured joints, then obtain a fresh observation and plan; allow enough control budget for both the correction and contact motion
supporting_attempts: attempt 2: repeated small seventh-joint excursions blocked contact previews; a longer bounded correction moved it inside temporarily
principles.limits: The correction did not remain effective through later trajectories in this attempt.

principles.applicability: A side-hinged door has a visible handle and an articulated grasp sequence is available.
failure_signals: image-motion intent conflicts with adjacent-depth direction
closure gap or visual appearance is mistaken for a grasp or success
conditional_actions: Inspect a view that resolves the handle, panel and hinge together
if direction remains genuinely unclear, use the documented unknown hint so the depth prior is explicit, then treat the joint as a hypothesis
execute a planned jaw-axis sequence, inspect measured object motion and native task_success, and replan a smaller arc from updated geometry when progress is measured but incomplete
supporting_attempts: attempt 3: side-view model plus jaw-axis sequence measured about 69.6 degrees of opening; a fresh 25-degree arc then returned native success
attempt 6: repeated the side-view model and 90-degree jaw-axis sequence; native success terminated execution
principles.limits: Two successes on this microwave setup, not broad generalization. The hinge model was single-view and depth-directed; pad-gap evidence did not verify a physical pinch. Attempt 6 ended by native success before a final measured angle was reported.
